name: Stanbic
source: CRON 20261014: Stanbic IBTC Holdings Plc interim consolidated and separate statements of profit or loss for the six month period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), Group 30-Jun-26 column, N'million scaled to naira. Revenue is the printed Gross earnings, which the filing states includes interest income, gross fees and commission, trading revenue and the net insurance service result, and which its own summary shows rising 27.15 per cent year on year. Operating Expenses is the printed Operating expenses, stored negative to match this convention. Income Tax is the printed Income tax charge, stored positive as a charge.
